risks: For `PR-DAEO-l78m.md` I read "keeps its own verdict word" as the word the record was committed with (`pass`, judged by the orchestrator), not the reviewer's own `fail`. lessons: A probe record's front matter must carry all nine schema fields and a full 40-character `probed_commit`, and `judgement` may only be one of the four words. Any explanation (supersession, how a verdict was computed) belongs in the body.
